text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl wasn't feeling well, so 
I decided to let her rest in the 
infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, Trainer. A little rest and 
I'll be fine.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, where on earth am I? Japan... no, 
it doesn't seem like the real world at 
all.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Eek!! What is this squishy creature!? It's 
coming this way...!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Stooop! Isn't attacking so suddenly a 
terrible breach of manners!?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
First, we talk! Tell me why you're 
attacking!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Wait, it looks like Japanese won't work. 
In that case—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Let's body language! Let us speak from the 
soul!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see... Ah, I get it. You had a 
fight with your friend and were feeling 
frustrated, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, you shouldn't take it out on 
someone else. Times like this are when you 
open up and speak from the heart!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Come on, let it all out! I'll embrace it! 
Even if our species differ, we are 
borderless!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"And let us laugh together as a proof of 
our friendship! A smile is a universal 
language, after all! Ohohoho!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Language barriers are no problem at all! 
Different species really can understand 
each other after all!!

Did having that dream put her in high 
spirits? Seeking the Pearl seemed to have 
gotten back in shape!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Oh no, you're even madder than before!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... I couldn't get my feelings 
across... My body language still has a 
long way to go.

Did she have a dream full of regrets? 
Seeking the Pearl never recovered her 
condition.
